plan.major: Drone Technician (Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems Technician)
plan.notes: Source: Blinn College District official Drone Technician AAS award plan page ('Small Unmanned Aircraft Systems Technician AAS Degree', CIP 15.0303; blinn.edu/academics/degree-certificates/drone-technician-aas.html; Approved 8/13/2021, Effective 9/1/2021), the current award plan referenced by the 2024-2025 Catalog Vol. 85. Semester sequence and credit hours transcribed exactly: 14/16/15/15 = 60 credits. Semester 4: the paired 'ANY BLINN COLLEGE COURSE ...' / 'or ANY BLINN COLLEGE COURSE ...' rows are single 3-credit elective slots (two identical slots), and the 'American History/Government' + two 'or ... SOCIAL/BEHAVIORAL SCIENCES' rows are a single 3-credit core slot — the only reading under which the semester sums to its declared 15. The award plan is a suggested sequence. No courses invented.

courses.title: Special Topics in Aeronautical and Aerospace Engineering Technology/Technician

First of two identical slots in this semester.
